note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 25a0665638: the tests build the resolver with Servers: []string{addr} instead of Server: addr, and Resolver.query now asks each server in turn through queryServer, which sets SetEdns0(4096, validating) on every query (resolver.go:418) and applies dnssecDecision to every answer. With one server the tagged units drive the same path. The A+RRSIG and DNSSEC-only assertions are unchanged. Prior judgement: an A+RRSIG answer must return exactly the A record and a DNSSEC-only answer (RRSIG, NSEC, DNSKEY) must yield no records and no error, so mishandling either way goes red
